rationale: As the assigning justice, Thomas is most likely to keep the opinion with himself or give it to Barrett/Kavanaugh to write a narrow, Reed-centered mootness holding keyed to § 6330’s levy-specific remedial structure. The dissent is most likely by Sotomayor or Roberts, with a meaningful chance of separate dissents (or a principal dissent plus a short add-on) emphasizing Chafin/Knox effectual-relief and voluntary-cessation concerns.
